overview.about: The Mizuho Americas Open is played at Liberty National in Jersey City, with the Manhattan skyline as its backdrop. It uniquely pairs the LPGA field with elite junior girls from the AJGA, spotlighting the next generation of the women's game.
overview.nextEvent: The next Mizuho Americas Open is played at Liberty National Golf Club across the water from New York City. The junior-girls tie-in and the dramatic skyline setting set it apart from a standard tour stop.
